sql: WITH season_ratings AS (SELECT s.id AS series_id, s.primary_title AS series_title, e.season_number, ROUND(AVG(ep.average_rating), 2) AS season_avg_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS episode_count FROM titles s JOIN episodes e ON s.id = e.parent_id JOIN titles ep ON e.id = ep.id WHERE s.title_type = 'tvSeries' AND ep.average_rating IS NOT NULL AND e.season_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.primary_title, e.season_number), series_stats AS (SELECT series_id, series_title, COUNT(*) AS total_seasons, MAX(CASE WHEN season_number = (SELECT MIN(season_number) FROM season_ratings sr2 WHERE sr2.series_id = sr.series_id) THEN season_avg_rating END) AS first_season_rating, MAX(CASE WHEN season_number = (SELECT MAX(season_number) FROM season_ratings sr2 WHERE sr2.series_id = sr.series_id) THEN season_avg_rating END) AS last_season_rating FROM season_ratings sr GROUP BY series_id, series_title HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT series_title, total_seasons, first_season_rating, last_season_rating, ROUND((first_season_rating - last_season_rating) / first_season_rating * 100, 2) AS decline_rate_pct FROM series_stats ORDER BY decline_rate_pct DESC

issues.message: 外层 SELECT 无 LIMIT 子句。但根据 run_sql LIMIT 规范，SQL 中不写 LIMIT，改为通过 run_sql 的 limit 参数控制（本查询取 Top 10，将传 limit=10）。run_sql 服务端默认 cap 1000 行，无数据量爆炸风险。
issues.suggestion: 通过 run_sql(sql, limit=10) 控制返回行数

issues.message: series_stats CTE 中使用相关子查询 (SELECT MIN/MAX(season_number) FROM season_ratings sr2 WHERE sr2.series_id = sr.series_id) 计算首末季评分。这是计算首季/末季评分的必要逻辑，改写为 JOIN 会显著增加复杂度且语义风险高。
issues.suggestion: 保留现有相关子查询，语义正确且数据量可控

summary: 共发现 2 个性能问题，0 个高风险。SQL 已较优：无 SELECT *、所有 JOIN 均有 ON 条件、无 NOT IN、无函数包裹列、有 ORDER BY。LIMIT 通过 run_sql 参数控制，相关子查询为必要逻辑，均无需修改 SQL。
